definitions.explanation: An official holiday designated by the government, when schools and most businesses are closed.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}は{祝日|しゅくじつ}で{学校|がっこう}が{休|やす}みだ。
examples.english: Tomorrow is a national holiday, so school is closed.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{年間|ねんかん}16{日|にち}の{祝日|しゅくじつ}がある。
examples.english: Japan has 16 national holidays per year.

examples.japanese: {祝日|しゅくじつ}が{日曜日|にちようび}と{重|かさ}なると{振替|ふりかえ}{休日|きゅうじつ}になる。
examples.english: When a national holiday falls on Sunday, the following Monday becomes a substitute holiday.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{祝|しゅく} (celebration) + {日|じつ} (day)

JAPANESE NATIONAL HOLIDAYS:
・{元日|がんじつ} (1/1) - New Year's Day
・{成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ} (Jan 2nd Mon) - Coming of Age Day
・{建国記念|けんこくきねん}の{日|ひ} (2/11) - National Foundation Day
・{天皇誕生日|てんのうたんじょうび} (2/23) - Emperor's Birthday
・{春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ} (Mar ~21) - Vernal Equinox Day
・{昭和|しょうわ}の{日|ひ} (4/29) - Showa Day
・{憲法記念日|けんぽうきねんび} (5/3) - Constitution Memorial Day
・みどりの{日|ひ} (5/4) - Greenery Day
・こどもの{日|ひ} (5/5) - Children's Day
・{海|うみ}の{日|ひ} (Jul 3rd Mon) - Marine Day
・{山|やま}の{日|ひ} (8/11) - Mountain Day
・{敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ} (Sep 3rd Mon) - Respect for the Aged Day
・{秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ} (Sep ~23) - Autumnal Equinox Day
・{文化|ぶんか}の{日|ひ} (11/3) - Culture Day
・{勤労感謝|きんろうかんしゃ}の{日|ひ} (11/23) - Labor Thanksgiving Day

RELATED TERMS:
・{休日|きゅうじつ} - day off, holiday (general)
・{振替|ふりかえ}{休日|きゅうじつ} - substitute holiday
・{国民|こくみん}の{祝日|しゅくじつ} - national holiday (formal term)
